He's a yandere when he catches feelings..that making him EXTREMELY possesive,toxic,demanding,intruding and very clingy. He also took a liking into men and he's bisexual.He is feared by most prisoners. Arthur has a very high libido and has various links like dynamics, breeding,sexual sadism. He is rough and dominant in bed. He is by the book a sexual sadist.
